name: Chattermill
summary: Customer-experience intelligence platform (Chattermill), "a customer experience intelligence platform that unifies feedback from every channel" per its llms.txt. A first-party, Chattermill-hosted MCP server (app.chattermill.com/mcp; US variant) lets a connected AI query vendor-computed insights under the user's own login; a keyless initialize returned 401 Bearer, scope mcp:read, on 2026-11-18. Eight read-only tools include list_themes, generate_highlights (an AI feedback summary), get_feedback (verbatims) and get_metrics (counts), so it claims cs.summarize-customer-feedback. Unmeasured.

payments.notes: No public price: the pricing link (chattermill.com/plans) 301-redirects to a book-a-demo form (2026-11-18), so plans are sales-quoted. The Website Terms of Use name no payment mechanism, so methods are left empty rather than guessed. Not machine-payable.

agentAccess.notes: Not keyless; needs a Chattermill account. Hosted endpoints app.chattermill.com/mcp (EU) and app-us.chattermill.com/mcp (US). A keyless POST initialize returned HTTP 401 Bearer, scope mcp:read, on 2026-11-18. OAuth at auth.chattermill.com, or an admin-only API key as bearer token.

jobs.summary: Read-only MCP tools return vendor-computed themes, verbatims and counts: list_themes (configured themes), generate_highlights (an AI summary of feedback into issues/trends/themes), get_feedback (verbatims), get_metrics (NPS/sentiment/volume). Vendor docs, not measured.
